description_en: Queries a list of driver versions by page
description_zh: 分页查询驱动版本列表
name: QueryEdgeDriverVersion

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This parameter is not required for public instances but is required for Enterprise Edition instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The driver ID. To obtain the ID, go to the Driver Management page in the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list) and move the pointer over the name of the target driver.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the driver ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en: The driver version number. If you specify this parameter, only the driver version that matches the specified version number is queried
parameters.help_zh: 驱动版本号。设置该参数表示仅查询该版本号匹配的驱动版本信息
parameters.name: driver_version

parameters.help_en:
The status of the driver version. Valid values:
0: Queries unpublished driver versions.
1: Queries published driver versions
parameters.help_zh:
驱动版本状态。

0：表示查询未发布的驱动版本。
1：表示查询已发布的驱动版本
parameters.name: version_state

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

Argument.description_en: The Java Virtual Machine (JVM) startup parameters

ConfigCheckRule.description_en:
The configuration check rule. The value is a JSON-formatted string in the following format:

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}`

The parameters are described as follows:

driverConfig: the configuration check rule for the driver in the edge instance.

deviceConfig: the configuration check rule for the devices under the driver in the edge instance
ConfigCheckRule.description_zh:
配置校验规则。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}`

参数说明如下。

driverConfig：表示边缘实例中该驱动的配置校验规则。

deviceConfig：表示边缘实例中该驱动下设备的配置校验规则

ContainerConfig.description_en: The container configuration. The value is a JSON-formatted string. For parameter descriptions, see the ContainerConfig table below in this topic
ContainerConfig.description_zh: 容器配置。JSON格式字符串参数说明，请参见本文下方ContainerConfig表格

DriverConfig.description_en:
The driver configuration. The value is a JSON-formatted string in the following format:

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

The parameters are described as follows:

format: the configuration format. Valid values: KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).
content: the configuration content. If the format parameter is set to KV or JSON, this parameter specifies the configuration content. If the format parameter is set to FILE, this parameter specifies the OSS URL
DriverConfig.description_zh:
驱动配置。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

参数说明如下所示。

format：配置格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）。
content：配置内容。format为KV或JSON时，此处为配置内容；format为FILE时，此处为OSS地址

EdgeVersion.description_en: The Link IoT Edge version that the driver is compatible with

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was created

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新驱动的Unix时间戳

SourceConfig.description_en:
The source configuration of the driver code. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip","temporaryOssAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip?Expires***"}`

In the preceding format, `ossAddress` is the Object Storage Service (OSS) URL, and `temporaryOssAddress` is a temporary URL that can be used to directly download the driver code. The temporary URL is valid for 5 minutes
SourceConfig.description_zh:
驱动代码来源配置。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip","temporaryOssAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip?Expires***"}`

其中，`ossAddress`为对象存储（OSS）访问地址，`temporaryOssAddress`为可以直接下载的临时链接，有效期5分钟

VersionState.description_en:
The status of the driver version. Valid values:
0: The version is unpublished.
1: The version is published
VersionState.description_zh:
驱动版本状态。

0：表示该版本未发布。
1：表示该版本已发布

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
